CBI arrests two NCB Sub-Inspectors in alleged ₹25-lakh bribery case
 The accused have been identified as Ajit Singh Meena, posted as an Investigating officer; and Sumeet Kumar
 Updated - November 16, 2026 11:03 pm IST - NEW DELHI 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested two Sub-Inspectors of the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) in an alleged bribery case, the agency said on Monday (November 16, 2026).
 The accused have been identified as Ajit Singh Meena, posted as an Investigating officer; and Sumeet Kumar. “The CBI registered the instant case on November 14, 2026, against the accused Sub-Inspector/Investigating Officer, Narcotics Control Bureau, Delhi Zonal Unit, R.K. Puram, New Delhi, based on a complaint,” the agency said.
 “It was alleged that the accused Sub-Inspector/Investigating Officer demanded a bribe of Rs.50 lakh from the complainant for not falsely implicating the complainant in a case under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act,” the CBI said.
 During verification, the agency found that the main accused had demanded ₹25 lakh and agreed to accept ₹12 lakh as part payment. Accordingly, it laid a trap and arrested the two Sub-Inspectors while they were allegedly receiving ₹12 lakh. The CBI secured two-day custody of the accused from a special court.
